response.sql:
WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
above_mean AS (
  SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_fee_rate,
         avg_fee_rate - AVG(avg_fee_rate) OVER () AS excess
  FROM pair_averages
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_fee_rate, excess,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS pair_rank
  FROM above_mean
  WHERE avg_fee_rate > (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) FROM pair_averages)
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_fee_rate, excess, pair_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE pair_rank <= 3;

assumptions.assumption: The mean of all pair averages is computed across all matched (orderslink, account scope) pairs, including pairs whose average fee rate is NULL; SQL AVG ignores NULL values.
